actualScope.coverage: Read both complete target manuscripts and diagram JSON before reading the complete English source and original diagram. Compared titles, descriptions, all prose, section structure, table, image alt, diagram title/description/all five steps, license/platform distinctions, conditions/uncertainty, documented evaluation versus proposed evaluation, numbers/units, all code fences, links and inline code.

findings.reason: The English diagram explicitly says “to at most 1”. The Russian formulation is understandable as an upper bound, but spelling out the maximum makes it clearer that vectors below length 1 remain unchanged. This is a precision suggestion rather than a demonstrated semantic error.

findings.quote: Limitar la magnitud / de la dirección a 1
findings.reason: The English diagram explicitly says “to at most 1”. The Spanish wording is a normal way of expressing a limit, but adding “como máximo” makes the cap unmistakable rather than suggesting normalization. The manuscript correctly preserves partial input magnitude.
findings.proposedFix: Limitar la magnitud / de la dirección a un máximo de 1
